note: Robinhood Chain mainnet team wallets. All keys are held by the team; these are public addresses only.

roles.safe: Owns every contract; receives the dev share; signs team actions (2 signatures)
roles.deployer: Deploys the contracts once on launch day (then hands ownership to the Safe) and holds house agents #1-5
roles.guardian: Can only press the emergency stop (AgentConfig.pause)
roles.engine: The trading engine's wallet; may only trade inside each holder's limits
